name: ccb
description: Bridge that drives interactive Claude Code sessions from external UIs; channel surface for the @ccb stack. The MCP server entry spawns the workspace channel-server bin via ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}, so users start claude from the claude-code-bridge repo root. CCB_BRIDGE_ENDPOINT and CCB_SESSION_ID are populated at session start by ccb itself; the values here are placeholders meant to be overridden by the bridge before claude launches.
